Name: COOL_TIME_PARAM_ST
Description: Multiplayer cooldown times. Each row holds a limitation time and an observation time for each number of co-op clients (0 to 3).

Fields.Name: Limitation Time: 0 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: Time limit when there are no co-op clients. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Observation Time: 0 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: Observation time when there are no co-op clients. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Limitation Time: 1 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: Time limit when there is 1 co-op client. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Observation Time: 1 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: Observation time when there is 1 co-op client. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Limitation Time: 2 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: Time limit when there are 2 co-op clients. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Observation Time: 2 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: Observation time when there are 2 co-op clients. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Limitation Time: 3 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: Time limit when there are 3 co-op clients. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Observation Time: 3 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: Observation time when there are 3 co-op clients. In seconds.
